item.title: Skanska rebuilds middle school in Tampa, Florida, USA, for USD 77M, about SEK 720M
item.description: STOCKHOLM, Feb. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Skanska has signed a contract with Hillsborough County Public Schools to rebuild Stewart Middle Magnet School in Tampa, Florida, USA. The contract is worth USD 77M, about SEK 720M, which will be included in the US order bookings for the first quarter of 2026.
